name: Rain's Maple Quiz 5

other.description: Answer the NPC quiz question correctly on completion (see dialogue.on_completion.quiz).

journal.raw:
Rain's fifth question. Wonder what it's about.
What's the fifth question?
Rain asked about job advancements. Warriors, Thieves, Bowmen, and Magicians all need to be at least level 10 to advance.

lines.text: You're inching closer and closer toward making your job advancement. I wonder which job you're going to pick. Now, talk to me when you're ready for the 5th question.

segments.text: You're inching closer and closer toward making your job advancement. I wonder which job you're going to pick. Now, talk to me when you're ready for the 5th question.

chips.label: Quiz
chips.title: This NPC asks you a quiz question

question.text: In order to make the job advancement as a Warrior, Bowman, or Thief, you have to be at least level 10. What level do you have to be to make the job advancement as a Magician?

segments.text: In order to make the job advancement as a Warrior, Bowman, or Thief, you have to be at least level 10. What level do you have to be to make the job advancement as a Magician?

quiz.wrong_answer_heading: If you pick the wrong answer

wrong_answer_responses.text: Not only Warriors, Bowmen, and Thieves, but Magicians also advance at level 10.

segments.text: Not only Warriors, Bowmen, and Thieves, but Magicians also advance at level 10.

correct_answer_response.text: Ding! To advance for not only Warriors, Bowmen, and Thieves, but also Magicians, you need to be at least level 10. Warriors can advance in Perion, Bowmen in Henesys, Magicians in Ellinia, and Thieves in Kerning City. Think about which job you'd like to choose!

notes: Quiz choices are listed in MeowDB document order, which is the in-game selection order (#L0, #L1, ...; quiz 6 leaks a raw "#L2" tag exactly at position 2). MeowDB renders the choice rows nested inside each other (a markup artifact); the extractor flattens them in document order. choices[].correct is MeowDB's marker: true = marked "Correct answer", false = rendered as an option and not marked, null = option reconstructed from unparsed game markup (raw_markup). Wrong-answer responses are listed in MeowDB order and are not linked to a specific choice by MeowDB.
gaps: MeowDB has no maximum level for quests (max_level is null).
MeowDB has no map-visit objectives or per-objective map restrictions for quests.
MeowDB does not say which "On completion" lines are shown before vs after the reward is given, or how dialogue pages are split into NPC chat windows.
